page: Google Cloud Platform c2d-highcpu-112 is a compute-optimized instance built on the x86_64 AMD EPYC 7B13 processor. It features 112 dedicated virtual CPUs across 56 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading, backed by 224 GB of system memory, yielding a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. Cache configuration includes 32 KB L1 data cache, 0.5 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB L3 cache. Cryptographic instructions such as AES, VAES, and SHA-NI are supported, alongside AVX, BMI2, and FMA, whereas AVX-512 extensions and hardware accelerators are not included. The server does not bundle local storage, requiring network-attached persistent disks for all non-volatile storage operations.

Benchmark results show top-tier multi-threaded compute capability, highlighted by a stress-ng multi-core score of 164,157.35 and a PassMark CPU score of 94,729.97. Extended instruction and encryption tests place in the top 10 percent of evaluated systems. Memory throughput is substantial, delivering 7,743.98 GB/sec in cached small-block reads and 274.99 GB/sec in large-block read operations. Parallel execution performance remains strong across real-world workloads, demonstrated by high Geekbench software compilation and ray-tracing marks, alongside static web serving throughput reaching 49.73 GB/sec and Redis SET operations exceeding 121 million operations per second.

The primary tradeoff of the c2d-highcpu-112 profile is its moderate per-core memory capacity and mid-tier single-threaded performance, as indicated by a Geekbench single-core score of 1,656.0. Without integrated local NVMe storage or discrete GPUs, data persistence depends on remote network storage latency, and large-scale model inference throughput remains bounded by CPU execution. Consequently, the instance delivers high compute efficiency for CPU-bound, heavily parallel workloads, including distributed build systems, large-scale CI/CD pipelines, batch processing, video rendering, scientific simulations, and high-concurrency web serving tiers.
description: Google Cloud Platform c2d-highcpu-112 is a compute-optimized virtual machine featuring 112 dedicated vCPUs derived from 56 physical AMD EPYC 7B13 cores on x86_64 architecture. The system provides 224 GB of RAM, offering a compute-focused ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU, without bundled local storage or dedicated hardware accelerators. In synthetic and application benchmarks, the instance demonstrates top-tier multi-core computing power, logging a stress-ng multi-core metric of 164,157.35 and high memory throughput of 274.99 GB/sec on large read blocks. Single-thread performance and per-core memory allocation remain moderate, making the server best suited for parallel compilation, ray tracing, CI/CD pipelines, web serving, and distributed batch processing.
